title: Transcript
description: Language-independent contract for the scribe transcript working document (the *.scribe.json edited by the scribe plugin, portunix-plugins #113, and read by a future VS Code transcript editor). A media reference + speakers + timed segments + assistant-placed flags. The JSON is the working source of truth during correction; the transcript Markdown is the seed/input and a render target. Files using this format use the '.scribe.json' filename suffix. PROVISIONAL: field names/layout may still change once reconciled against a real transcript sample (portunix-plugins #113, acceptance criterion 15); 'schema_version' tracks that evolution.

source.description: Link to the recording: relative path, absolute path, or URL

span.description: Location in the recording [start, end] in seconds; null defaults to the segment timing

source_text.description: Original STT text, kept for non-destructive diff/undo
